purpose: Allow translation-only constrained assemblies spanning mounts, exact distance joints and slack distance limits to opt into deterministic intra-component collision isolation during the preserved donor-core collision stage without rewriting the donor solver or silently overwriting caller collision-group semantics.

properties.constraints: constraint-composer translation mounts, exact distance joints and/or distance limits
properties.options: optional isolation enabled flag plus nested composer options

relationships.basis: The donor core remains byte-for-byte untouched; isolation is expressed by a temporary caller-side collision-group projection around the donor collision step.

limitations: isolation applies to whole connected constraint components rather than direct constraint edges only
a slack distance-limit edge still joins bodies into one isolation component even while that limit is not actively transmitting correction
components containing any nonzero caller collision.group are skipped rather than overridden
only translation mounts, center-to-center distance joints and center-distance limits are understood
no angular inertia, rotating local anchors, hinge, slider, rotational weld, motor or gear semantics
core contact evidence describes the temporary-group collision stage before caller groups are restored
persistent_state: none; temporary collision groups are derived per step and caller groups are restored before returning

proves: overlapping constrained bodies can be excluded from donor-core contacts when isolation is eligible
a distance-limit-only edge forms an isolation component without changing its slack physics semantics
all three supported constraint families contribute deterministic component topology
caller collision groups are restored on the final world
existing nonzero caller group semantics cause an explicit skip rather than silent override
temporary negative groups are allocated deterministically while avoiding ids already present in the world

truth.basis: The capability names its component-wide behavior, including the fact that even slack limit edges affect isolation topology, exposes skipped components and preserves the exact donor collision-stage world used for contact evidence.

agency.basis: Isolation is explicit and caller-controlled, and existing nonzero collision-group choices are not overwritten.

continuity.basis: It grows with the established mixed-constraint lane and preserved donor source rather than replacing either.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: Collision suppression remains bounded to deterministic connected components and declines ambiguous existing group semantics instead of guessing.
